test_title: PYST 36: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: S, T, U, V, W, X and Y are seven students in a class who scored different marks in an exam. X scored less marks than only V and Y. U scored the lowest marks. W scored less marks than S but more than T. V scored the highest marks. What would be W’s rank if the student scoring the highest marks was given rank 1 and the student scoring the lowest marks was given rank 7?
solution:
According to the situations:

X scored less marks than only V and Y-

**V > Y > X** or **Y > V >X**

U scored the lowest marks-

**_ > _ > _ > _ > _ > _ > U** 

W scored less marks than S but more than T-

**S > W >T**

V scored the highest marks-

**V >_ >_ >_ >_ >_ >_**

The final order of students scoring marks will look like-

**V > Y > X > S > W > T > U**

**By this, the rank of W will be 5th.**

**Hence, the correct answer is Option (2).**
